identity: A UR Elementals deck whose damage comes from casting expensive spells rather than from connecting in combat. Enraged Flamecaster converts every mana-value-4-or-greater cast into 2 damage to each opponent; Twinflame Travelers doubles that and every other Elemental trigger; Kulrath Mystic and Tanufel Rimespeaker turn the same cast into a 4/4 vigilant attacker and a card. Ashling, Rimebound and Flamebraider produce mana that can ONLY be spent on exactly those big spells, so the first mana-value-4-or-greater CAST happens on turn 3; because the cheapest payoff on the battlefield costs 3 mana, the first payoff TRIGGER lands on turn 4 rather than turn 5. Thirteen of the twenty-two nonland cards have mana value 4 or greater, so the trigger is not a corner case - it is the deck's normal turn.

restrictions.copy_limits: PASS — no common or uncommon above 2 copies, no rare or mythic above 1. Basic lands (Mountain x7, Island x6) are format-supplied and exempt.
restrictions.rare_mythic_cap: PASS — exactly 5 of 5 used, all mainboard: Ashling Rekindled // Ashling Rimebound, Champion of the Path, Sunderflock, Ashling's Command, Steam Vents. The sideboard contains zero rares or mythics.
restrictions.colour_identity: PASS — every nonland card is usable in {U, R} via effective_cost.best_mode; no splash.

sideboard.name: Rooftop Percher
sideboard.oracle_text:
Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
Flying
When this creature enters, exile up to two target cards from graveyards. You gain 3 life.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against any graveyard deck. Graveyard interaction is the cube's single largest threat class at 39 of 277 cards (14%). 'When this creature enters, exile up to two target cards from graveyards' is the only graveyard answer available to these colours, and because Changeling makes it an Elemental at mana value 5, it is also a payoff trigger and a Champion of the Path trigger.

sideboard.name: Spell Snare
sideboard.oracle_text: Counter target spell with mana value 2.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against decks whose key card costs 2. This is the mainboard's conceded threat class (stack) bought back after sideboarding.

sideboard.name: Cinder Strike
sideboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may blight 1. (You may put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.)
Cinder Strike deals 2 damage to target creature. It deals 4 damage to that creature instead if this spell's additional cost was paid.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against fast starts, paired with Tweeze. One mana for 4 damage to a creature when the blight cost is paid is the cheapest interaction in the colours. It is a SORCERY, so it is the slower half of the anti-race package, and the 4-damage mode puts a -1/-1 counter on one of the deck's own Elementals - which is why it is 1 copy.

sideboard.name: Tweeze
sideboard.oracle_text: Tweeze deals 3 damage to any target. You may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against fast or evasive starts, alongside Cinder Strike. 'Tweeze deals 3 damage to any target. You may discard a card. If you do, draw a card' - unlike Cinder Strike it is an INSTANT, it can go to the face to finish a race, and it replaces itself instead of costing a card.

sideboard.name: Giantfall
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
• Destroy target artifact.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against artifacts (11 in the cube, and it is one of only 4 artifact answers in the whole pool). Mode one, 'Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls', is live off a 7/3 Champion of the Path or a 6/5 Kulrath Zealot.

sideboard.name: Temporal Cleansing
sideboard.oracle_text:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
The owner of target nonland permanent puts it into their library second from the top or on the bottom.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against enchantments (21 in the cube). No U or R card in this cube destroys an enchantment — all 4 enchantment answers are G/W/UG — so this bounce-to-library effect, invisible to a destroy-probe, is the colours' only answer. Also still mana value 4.

sideboard.name: Rimekin Recluse
sideboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, return up to one other target creature to its owner's hand.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against auras and equipment, and against decks with one oversized creature. 'When this creature enters, return up to one other target creature to its owner's hand' resets an enchanted or equipped threat and is an Elemental body on a mana-value-3 tempo turn.
